source.note: exactly the 80,000 samples of speech_pcm.h that the silicon bench (bringup/codec-bench) encoded: voicenote.wav samples 43520..123519, frames 136..385, leading silence skipped by wav_to_c.py

encoder.api: opus_encoder (standard), fresh encoder: opus_encoder_create then apply_settings() in opus_codec.c order
encoder.library_build_flags: FIXED_POINT=1 DISABLE_FLOAT_API OPUS_BUILD VAR_ARRAYS OPUS_VERSION=1.5.2, -Os, no asm/intrinsics/RTCD, portable C; sources = voiceNotetaker/lib/opus file list (CMakeLists.txt)
encoder.generator: make_app_fixture.c against libopus unknown-fixed (fixed point, firmware file list: opus-golden/opus-fw/libopus_fw.a)

decoded.decoder: fresh opus_decoder, 16000 Hz, 1 ch, frame_size capacity 1920, s16le

plc.rule: first frame at or after index 60 whose lossless decoded RMS >= median frame RMS of the 250 (median = mean of the two middle values = 162.08)

float_decoder.note: decodes the SAME packets as above (fixed-point encoder output = what the device sends). This build dispatches SIMD at run time (OPUS_HAVE_RTCD, x86 SSE..AVX2); results were produced on x86-64 and are not guaranteed bit-exact on other CPUs (e.g. ARM/NEON phones) -- use the rms/ratio figures for coarse checks there.
float_decoder.decoder: fresh opus_decoder per decode, 16000 Hz, 1 ch, capacity 1920 (320 for NULL/PLC)

plc_scan.method: for every k in 10..239: fresh decoder, packets 0..249 with packet k replaced by opus_decode(NULL,0,..,320,0); ratio = rms(concealed frame k) / rms(frame k of the SAME decoder's lossless decode). p5/median: linear interpolation between closest ranks.
